title: CONNECT-UDP Tunnel Setup Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 CONNECT-UDP tunnel setup decisions before live UDP packet forwarding.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpTunnelSetupPolicy` reconstructs the CONNECT-UDP request target from validated HTTP/3 headers and a URI Template, decodes `target_host` and `target_port`, selects the UDP socket endpoint, gates success responses on DNS completion and socket-open state without waiting for a target packet, rejects setup errors, emits Proxy-Status details, and exposes the client abort decision for non-2xx responses.
data_and_state_considerations: The helper is pure setup policy. It returns endpoint and response decisions but does not create or own an operating-system UDP socket.
edge_cases_and_constraints: DNS names require a resolved address before endpoint creation.
IP literals do not require DNS gating.
Template mismatches and prohibited target addresses fail before a success response.
risks: Live UDP socket lifetime and source endpoint validation remain a separate lifecycle policy.
Adapter code still needs to map setup decisions to actual socket APIs.
